cards.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

cards.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
cards.rulesText: If a creature attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.flavor: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

cards.name: Lizard Blades
cards.rulesText:
Double strike
Equipped creature has double strike.
Reconfigure {2} ({2}: Attach to target creature you control; or unattach from a creature. Reconfigure only as a sorcery. While attached, this isn't a creature.)

cards.name: Treasure Nabber
cards.rulesText: Whenever an opponent taps an artifact for mana, gain control of that artifact until the end of your next turn.
cards.flavor: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

cards.name: Long River's Pull
cards.rulesText:
Gift a card (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they draw a card before its other effects.)
Counter target creature spell. If the gift was promised, instead counter target spell.

cards.name: Triskaidekaphile
cards.rulesText:
You have no maximum hand size.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand, you win the game.
{3}{U}: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

cards.name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
cards.rulesText:
First strike
Creatures and nonbasic lands your opponents control enter tapped.
cards.flavor: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

cards.name: Prosperous Innkeeper
cards.rulesText:
When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Cover of Darkness
cards.rulesText:
As this enchantment enters, choose a creature type.
Creatures of the chosen type have fear. (They can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.)

cards.name: In Garruk's Wake
cards.rulesText: Destroy all creatures you don't control and all planeswalkers you don't control.
cards.flavor: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

cards.name: Fell the Mighty
cards.rulesText: Destroy all creatures with power greater than target creature's power.
cards.flavor:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

cards.name: Fauna Shaman
cards.rulesText: {G}, {T}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.flavor: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

cards.name: Kessig Flamebreather
cards.rulesText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.flavor: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.

cards.name: Diamond Pick-Axe
Haliya, Guided by Light
cards.rulesText:
Whenever this card or another creature or artifact you control enters, you gain 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, draw a card if you've gained 3 or more life this turn.
Warp {W} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)

cards.name: Echoes of Eternity
cards.rulesText:
If a triggered ability of a colorless spell you control or another colorless permanent you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
Whenever you cast a colorless spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

cards.name: Deadeye Navigator
cards.rulesText:
Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.)
As long as this card is paired with another creature, each of those creatures has "{1}{U}: Exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield under your control."

cards.name: Wave Goodbye
cards.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
cards.rulesText: Return each creature without a +1/+1 counter on it to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: Whatever the tide brings in, the shapers can wash away.

cards.name: Rain of Riches
cards.rulesText:
When this enchantment enters, create two Treasure tokens.
The first spell you cast each turn that mana from a Treasure was spent to cast has cascade. (When you cast the spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom in a random order.)

cards.name: Apex Altisaur
cards.rulesText:
When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
cards.flavor: It brings belligerence to new heights.

cards.name: Obscuring Haze
cards.rulesText:
If you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures your opponents control.
cards.flavor: Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

cards.name: Odric, Lunarch Marshal
cards.rulesText: At the beginning of each combat, creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn if a creature you control has first strike. The same is true for flying, deathtouch, double strike, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, skulk, trample, and vigilance.

cards.name: Twitching Doll
cards.rulesText:
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Put a nest counter on this creature.
{T}, Sacrifice this creature: Create a 2/2 green Spider creature token with reach for each counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Guide of Souls
cards.rulesText:
Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life and get {E} (an energy counter).
Whenever you attack, you may pay {E}{E}{E}. When you do, put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target attacking creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Planar Genesis
cards.rulesText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't, put a card from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.flavor: Out of nothing, something was born.

cards.name: Witty Roastmaster
cards.rulesText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.flavor: If you're lucky, you'll walk out with just your ego singed.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.rulesText: {R}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.flavor: "Nothin' beat surprise—'cept rock."
